Backend Development Skills

REST API Development:
REST APIs allow applications to communicate using HTTP methods such
as GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, and DELETE.

Developers should understand request validation, response structures,
HTTP status codes, error handling, authentication, and API documentation.

FastAPI:
FastAPI is a Python framework for building APIs.
Important topics include path operations, Pydantic models, dependency
injection, middleware, exception handling, and automatic OpenAPI docs.

Testing:
Unit testing checks individual functions or components.
Integration testing verifies that multiple components work together.
API tests can validate status codes, response bodies, and error cases.

Databases:
SQL databases include PostgreSQL and MySQL.
NoSQL databases include MongoDB and Cassandra.

Deployment:
Application deployment makes software available in an environment
where users or other systems can access it.
Relevant concepts include Docker, environment variables, CI/CD pipelines,
logging, monitoring, and cloud infrastructure.

Microservices:
Microservices architecture separates an application into independently
deployable services. Important considerations include communication,
service discovery, monitoring, fault tolerance, and data consistency.

Machine Learning Skills

Python:
Python is commonly used for machine learning, data processing,
automation, and backend development.

Data Processing:
Candidates should understand data cleaning, missing values,
feature engineering, dataset splitting, and data leakage.

Model Evaluation:
Classification metrics include accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score.
A confusion matrix shows the relationship between actual and predicted
classes.

Overfitting:
Overfitting occurs when a model performs well on training data but
generalizes poorly to unseen data.
Possible techniques to address overfitting include data augmentation,
regularization, early stopping, and improved validation procedures.

Deep Learning:
Deep learning uses neural networks to learn representations from data.
Convolutional neural networks are commonly used for image classification.
